threat_event: Account takeover of a venue administrator account on the ticketing platform, followed by a patron data export and changes to checkout settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 34 venue accounts with local passwords and no MFA; 11 admins; no log review
existing_controls: Role-based permissions in the platform
treatment_plan: Enforce MFA for all venue users; cut admins to 3; alerts on new admins, setting changes, and bulk exports

threat_event: Malicious or compromised third-party script on the checkout page skims card data
threat_source: Cybercriminal (web skimming group) through a compromised tag vendor or agency account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 unmanaged scripts on the checkout page; agency can add scripts; no change detection
existing_controls: Vendor protects the code it controls
treatment_plan: Remove company-added scripts from checkout; restrict marketing settings; vendor change alerts

threat_event: Malware on a box office PC captures card numbers typed for phone orders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Box office PCs used for email and web browsing; signature anti-malware only; flat network
existing_controls: Signature anti-malware; automatic updates
treatment_plan: Move phone orders and window sales to validated P2PE devices so no card number reaches a PC

threat_event: Theft or misuse of paper phone-order slips holding card numbers and security codes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 41 slips in an unlocked binder; no disposal rule
existing_controls: Box office behind a badge door; CCTV
treatment_plan: Stop writing card data; shred all slips under witness; take phone payments live

threat_event: 2026 PCI DSS validation fails, leading to acquirer fees, higher processing rates, or loss of the ticketing merchant account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Scope undocumented; 2025 SAQ A misfiled; 54 PCI DSS gap rows under SAQ D
existing_controls: Acquirer letter sets the path
treatment_plan: Scope reduction (Option B) decision by 2026-09-30; evidence file for each SAQ answer

threat_event: Former employee or agency staff uses a still-active ticketing account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5 stale accounts; no same-day removal; agency accounts without end dates
existing_controls: HR emails the box office manager at termination
treatment_plan: Same-day removal from the HR ticket; monthly reconciliation; end dates on agency accounts

threat_event: Fraudulent refunds or complimentary tickets issued under the shared box office login
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared 'boxoffice' login prevents attribution
existing_controls: Supervisor approval for refunds over $200
treatment_plan: Named seasonal accounts; weekly refund and comp report reviewed by the Controller

threat_event: Stolen full-admin ticketing API key used to extract patron data or change checkout settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Key with full admin scope stored in function settings; never rotated since 2023
existing_controls: Cloud console protected by MFA
treatment_plan: Read-only scoped key in the key vault; rotate yearly; alert on key use from new addresses

threat_event: Ransomware on the corporate segment encrypts box office PCs, file shares, and the settlement app
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat corporate segment; no EDR; backups in the same cloud account
existing_controls: Signature anti-malware; MFA on cloud console
treatment_plan: EDR on all PCs; segment box office and finance; immutable separate-account backups

threat_event: Patron database and settlement backups destroyed along with production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup vault in the same account and region; never restore-tested
existing_controls: Daily backups
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: Ticketing platform outage during a major on-sale or at show entry
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single ticketing platform; scanners depend on it
existing_controls: Vendor availability commitments (SOC 2 Availability); scanners work offline for a downloaded manifest
treatment_plan: Confirm the vendor's recovery commitments in the contract; offline manifest download before every show

threat_event: Venue internet outage stops box office sales and scanner syncing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two ISPs but a single firewall
existing_controls: Primary fiber and backup cable internet
treatment_plan: Cellular failover for the box office; spare firewall on site

threat_event: Brokers' bots circumvent purchase limits during a high-demand on-sale
threat_source: Ticket brokers using bots, fake accounts, and proxies
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Limits enforced per account only; no linked-account checks; block logs kept 30 days
existing_controls: Vendor bot mitigation and virtual queue
treatment_plan: Linked-account checks; keep block evidence 12 months; refer serious cases to the FTC or state AG (P10)

threat_event: Bot mitigation blocks legitimate patrons, unevenly across patron groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: False positives not measured or reviewed; no appeal path
existing_controls: Guest services can manually release some blocks
treatment_plan: Measure block and challenge rates by access type; published appeal path (P10)

threat_event: Advertised ticket prices omit mandatory fees (FTC fee rule violation)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Website calendar and emails show base prices; no pre-publication check
existing_controls: Vendor checkout shows all-in prices
treatment_plan: Total price in every price display; pre-publication checklist; counsel review of fee labels

threat_event: Dynamic pricing surges seen as unfair, harming patron trust and artist relations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No ceiling rules per show; no review of price-change disclosures
existing_controls: Artist agreements set some price caps
treatment_plan: Price floors and ceilings per show approved with the artist; weekly pricing review (P10)

threat_event: Tampered or swapped P2PE card reader at a bar
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No recorded inspections; 2 readers unaccounted for
existing_controls: Validated P2PE; CCTV over all bars
treatment_plan: Pre-event inspection checklist; reconcile the inventory; annual training

threat_event: The 2 missing P2PE readers are used for fraud or break the P2PE listing conditions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inventory not reconciled since 2024
existing_controls: Readers are useless without the solution provider's keys
treatment_plan: Report to the POS vendor and have the readers disabled

threat_event: Default admin passwords on the CCTV recorder and door controller exploited to erase video or unlock the cash office
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator default passwords; reachable from the corporate segment (found in P07)
existing_controls: Physical keys to the cash office safe
treatment_plan: Change passwords; block corporate-to-CCTV traffic except from 2 admin PCs

threat_event: Touring crew equipment on the production segment spreads malware to the corporate segment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two open ports from production to corporate
existing_controls: Production segment separate from guest Wi-Fi
treatment_plan: Block production-to-corporate traffic

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects an artist settlement payment or changes a vendor's bank details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Settlement payments of $20,000 to $300,000 approved by email; no callback rule
existing_controls: MFA on email
treatment_plan: Callback verification on any payment detail change; phishing training for finance and booking staff

threat_event: Integrator's remote support tool compromised, giving access to the firewall, CCTV, and PCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on tool with password-only login
existing_controls: Integrator contract with confidentiality terms
treatment_plan: MFA and on-request sessions for the tool; annual supplier security review

threat_event: Patron export left in public object storage or emailed outside the company
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Exports in object storage without an access review; staff email exports to the agency
existing_controls: Storage not public by default
treatment_plan: Storage policy denying public access; share exports only through a controlled link with expiry

threat_event: Unsupported operating system on 2 box office PCs exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: End of vendor support in 2026-10
existing_controls: Automatic updates until end of support
treatment_plan: Replace or retire the 2 PCs with the P2PE change

threat_event: Error in the settlement app produces wrong artist payouts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contractor-built app; no change control or test records
existing_controls: Controller reviews every settlement sheet before payment
treatment_plan: Accept with the Controller's manual review; revisit when the app is changed

threat_event: Breach notices to the acquirer, Visa, patrons, or Florida missed or late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident response plan; staff unaware of the 24-hour acquirer term and card brand timelines
existing_controls: Cyber insurance breach hotline
treatment_plan: POL-03 and the P08 runbook; tabletop exercise

threat_event: Box office supervisor issues tickets and refunds to own card
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Refund approval threshold only; no report review
existing_controls: Daily box office reconciliation by the Controller's staff
treatment_plan: Weekly refund-to-card-match report

threat_event: Shared POS clerk logins at bars let voids and discounts go unattributed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One clerk login per bar
existing_controls: Bar manager counts inventory after each show
treatment_plan: Accept for 2026; named clerk logins when the POS contract renews

threat_event: Card-testing bots run small fraudulent authorizations through the checkout
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Checkout exposed to the internet (vendor-hosted)
existing_controls: Vendor fraud screening and rate limits
treatment_plan: Rely on vendor controls; monitor chargeback ratio monthly

threat_event: Privacy notice claims no third-party tracking on checkout pages while scripts are present
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notice written in 2021 and never reviewed
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Remove checkout scripts; rewrite the notice; annual review

threat_event: CCTV evidence unavailable after a safety or theft incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single recorder; 30-day retention; no health alerts
existing_controls: Recorder on UPS power
treatment_plan: Recorder health alerts; export clips on any incident report

threat_event: Former staff join the corporate Wi-Fi with the unchanged shared passphrase and reach the box office PCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Passphrase unchanged since 2024; Wi-Fi bridges into the corporate segment
existing_controls: Wi-Fi limited to the building
treatment_plan: Rotate the passphrase now; identity-based Wi-Fi sign-in

threat_event: Breach at the ticketing vendor exposes patron data held on the platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Company depends on the vendor's controls for 260,000 patron records
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 and PCI DSS AOC
treatment_plan: Contract clause: breach notice within 72 hours and cooperation; annual report review (P09)

threat_event: Scanner or ticketing failure at doors causes entry backups and crowd pressure outside
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written manual entry procedure
existing_controls: Offline scanner mode; security supervisors at doors
treatment_plan: Manual entry procedure (printed manifests, wristbands); drill each season
